language-modes.note: site/app.js applyLanguage() (line 539) switches document.lang and preview copy between English, Cantonese and bilingual, wired from initSettings() language-mode select. This is a real, wired switch but only changes one preview string, not the whole site's rendered copy - most page text has no data-copy hook.

funny-levels.note: site/app.js initSettings() wires english-funny and cantonese-funny sliders to state.englishFunny/state.cantoneseFunny (line 895) and applyCopy() (line 654) renders COPY table entries through copyText(key), which is the mechanism a funny level would style, but no inspection found actual per-level copy variants defined for englishFunny/cantoneseFunny beyond the language switch itself.

dialog-emojis.note: No show-emojis-in-dialogs toggle or emoji-decoration logic was found in site/app.js.

school-mode.note: No School mode setting, rename, or shared unlock credential was found anywhere in site/app.js or the settings page.

narration.note: No TTS narrator, voice picker, or spoken-event queue was found in site/app.js.

scheduled-settings.note: site/app.js initSettings() wires a schedule-enabled checkbox to state.scheduleEnabled, but no date/time rule editor, weekday selection, or external source integration was found - the checkbox exists with no scheduling surface behind it.

external-settings-sources.note: No HTTPS API or Home Assistant integration exists; same gap as scheduled-settings.

dim-sum-surprise.note: No startup dim-sum surprise or bundled dish assets were found.

regex-builder.note: site/app.js implements a real anchored regex builder: openRegex()/initRegex() (lines 808, 812) open a <dialog> attached to the triggering field (regex-target-label shows "Attached to: <field>"), support literal-insert buttons, i/m/u flags, and previewRegex() live matching, with applyRegex() writing the result back into the originating search field. Wired from every .regex-trigger button via initSearch() (line 807), including the settings search and documentation search.

non-blocking-notifications.note: site/app.js implements notify()/notification history (renderNotifications, notification-history dialog) with bulk select/dismiss (initNotificationBulk, planBulk with destructive flag), a notification-open dialog, and export of notification history (notificationExportRows). Wired end to end from init() (line 1055).

status-hub.note: site/status.html exists as a page shell but no live status-hub project, session card, or question-card logic was found in site/app.js.

material-appearance.note: site/app.js implements a genuine infinite-colour-picker/translator (rgbToHsl/hsvToRgb/rgbToLab/rgbToOklab/hwbToRgb/cmykToRgb and translateColour, wired via initColourTranslator) plus theme/density/accent/font-scale controls in initSettings() with a live preview (initSettingsPreview). This covers colour translation and basic tokens well, but there is no per-element "Edit appearance..." editor, no Word-depth typography controls, and no named-preset export/import beyond the general settings export.

app-logo-customization.note: site/app.js wires logo-file/logo-clear to loadLogo()/applyLogo() with a logo-status readout, storing the custom logo in localStorage. This is a real local-only upload and clear path, but there is no crop/fit/background editor, no multi-size generation, and no shipped preset gallery beyond the single custom-upload slot.

local-file-converter.note: The documentation site exposes converter.html with categorized local adapters, bounded byte inspection, a paged queue, cancellation, and an adjacent regex builder. This is implemented in site/app.js and converter.html but remains unverified because no build, browser session, or capture ran in this lane.

ollama-suite-manager.note: The documentation site exposes ollama.html as a browser-local loopback surface with explicit endpoint approval, bounded local API reads, pull and chat cancellation, and honest Unknown catalog completeness. It remains unverified because no build, browser session, or capture ran in this lane.

browser-style-tabs.note: The site is a small multi-page static site (index/product/documentation/downloads/settings/status.html navigated as separate pages); no in-page browser-style tab strip, docking, or tab groups were found in site/app.js.

tab-groups-and-searches.note: No tabs exist on the site at all (see browser-style-tabs), so there are no tab groups or tab searches.

command-palette.note: site/app.js implements openPalette() (line 816) opening a real <dialog id="command-palette"> with a live-filtered palette-search field and renderPalette(), wired from a palette-open button and Ctrl+Shift+F was not confirmed as the activation key (only a button click and palette-search input were found) - the keyboard-shortcut activation contract is unverified.

destructive-action-confirmation.note: site/app.js planBulk() and bulk actions carry a destructive flag (line 299, 309) that changes copy to state "This cannot be undone," and settings-reset is styled as a danger-button, but no two-key-plus-slider super-confirmation gate (the documented contract's specific mechanism) was found - only a plain destructive-labelled action.

local-version-history.note: The browser-local delivery workspace provides schema-versioned append-only event history, counted migration and normalization audits, date/action/text filtering, JSON import and round-trip export, presentation-only Markdown export, restore-as-new-event, retention accounting, and explicit refusal states. Built interaction remains unverified.

changelog-viewer.note: The delivery workspace renders the exact generated product release changelog with optional upstream history, real local calendar ranges, action and text filters, commit links, and filtered export. Built interaction remains unverified.

external-editor-handoff.note: The static page presents the local export and editor handoff boundary, retains prepared and browser-handoff states separately, and offers the official editor recovery route. A static browser page cannot launch a native editor, so no native handoff is claimed.

complete-exports.note: site/app.js implements a genuinely broad export pipeline: toJson/toJsonl/toYaml/toToml/toXml/toSql/toDelimited/toMarkdown/toHtml plus suitableFormats()/exportFilename()/download(), used by both initDocumentationExport() and the settings/notification export paths, with an explicit personalVocabulary:"omitted" marker in the settings export payload (line ~895) matching the export-honesty contract.

bulk-actions.note: site/app.js implements planBulk()/summariseBulk()/bulkClick()/bulkSelectAll() with a reviewable affected/skipped preview and a destructive flag, wired into notification bulk-select/dismiss (initNotificationBulk).

accessibility.note: site/app.js implements a real WCAG contrast calculator (contrastRatio/contrastVerdict) used by the colour translator, and sr-only labels appear in settings.html, but no site-wide audit of focus order, ARIA roles, or reduced-motion coverage beyond the one reduceMotion() check in the counter animation (line 967) was verified.

responsive-sizing.note: site/styles.css was not inspected for a systematic responsive strategy in this pass; no JS-level narrow-width handling (comparable to the app's "narrow" screen flag) was found in site/app.js.

personal-vocabulary-upload.note: site/app.js wires vocabulary-file/vocabulary-clear to loadVocabulary()/applyVocabulary(), with bounded validation of replacement entries (from/to length limits, line ~924) and a vocabulary-status readout, storing the cache in localStorage under ding-pbx-vocabulary-cache.

per-element-toy-locks.note: No per-element lock/unlock mechanism was found anywhere in site/app.js.

support-tickets.note: No Support Tickets surface exists on the site.

unlock-ladder.note: No unlock ladder (dim sum / sums / whack-a-mole / clock) exists; there is nothing to unlock in the first place (see per-element-toy-locks).

built-in-authenticator.note: No TOTP/authenticator surface, QR generation, or code display exists in site/app.js.

attention-modes.note: site/app.js implements real ADHD/attention accommodations wired in initSettings(): reduceFlashing, simplifiedLanguage, extendedTimeouts, focus, timeAwareness, oneThing (with updateOneThingBanner and a current-task field), and momentum (initMomentum/checkMomentum/updateSessionTimer), all persisted through state.attention and off by default per DEFAULTS.

browser-extension-download-surfaces.note: The static delivery workspace provides a browser-local File System Access equivalent with explicit preparation, destination, active write, cancellation, completion, interruption, and failure states. It does not claim native-extension ingress or always-on-top desktop windows.

offline-documentation-browser.note: site/documentation.html plus renderDestinations()/initDocumentationExport() in site/app.js present a searchable documentation catalogue with per-article export, but this is a static site consuming its own bundled catalogue over the network at page load, not an offline-bundled in-app documentation browser matching the console-app contract.

app-display-name.note: No renameable display-name setting was found on the site.

guided-forms.note: No guided/picker-driven form beyond ordinary settings selects and file inputs was found; there is no enumerated-picker-over-freeform-text pattern comparable to the app's endpoint wizard.

bounded-overlays.note: The regex builder (openRegex) and command palette (openPalette) both use native <dialog>.showModal(), which the browser bounds to the viewport and paints its own surface, and openRegex() explicitly labels which field it is attached to ("Attached to: <field>"). This satisfies the bounded/anchored-overlay contract for these two surfaces.

context-menu-shortcuts.note: The delivery workspace exposes target-specific keyboard-accessible context menus with local filters, shortcut labels, focus return, and actions limited to the selected panel or history row.

long-operation-progress.note: The delivery workspace separates preparation from browser handoff, reports measured byte progress, disables re-entry, exposes cancellation, and records interruption and terminal states without treating an unverified browser handoff as completion.

in-context-recovery.note: History, editor, forge preview, update, and browser-handoff panels expose target-specific adjacent recovery actions and exact local status without claiming a native or authenticated action the static page cannot perform.

provider-markup-rendering.note: The delivery workspace renders a bounded safe Markdown subset after escaping provider text. Raw HTML, scripts, images, unsafe links, and privileged rendering are refused. Built interaction remains unverified.

forge-publishing.note: The browser-local workspace provides a required source, destination, account, owner, repository, and route preview before opening a generic provider entry point. It does not authenticate, fork, copy, push, or store credentials, so native publication is not claimed.

collapsible-filters.note: site/settings.html and site/documentation.html use real <details class="collapsible-panel"> elements wrapping the search/filter controls (settings-filters-panel, documentation-filters-panel), wired to updateFilterStatus() in site/app.js which reports match counts into an aria-live status span - a genuine collapsible, accessible filter row.

automatic-updates.note: The static delivery workspace validates the versioned release manifest and exposes unavailable, available, downloading, ready, failed, cancelled, and unverified browser-handoff states without claiming installation. Built interaction remains unverified.
